acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unset/empty GitHub Actions variable results in a 900-second timeout value reaching the trigger.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The production workflow now uses the Actions expression fallback `vars.HUNTER_ISSUE_AGENT_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS || '900'`, so an unset or empty repository variable yields 900 instead of an empty string.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A configured valid timeout is propagated unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The Actions expression uses the configured repository variable when it is non-empty and only falls back to 900 otherwise.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invalid configured timeout values still fail closed in the trigger.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Trigger-side timeout parsing and validation are unchanged, including rejection of malformed, non-finite, non-positive and over-limit values.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Production workflow job timeout remains sufficient for the maximum supported webhook timeout plus setup overhead.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The production workflow job timeout is now 25 minutes, providing five minutes of setup headroom beyond the trigger's 1200-second maximum webhook timeout.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Live #441 trigger can proceed past timeout parsing after merge.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The empty-string failure condition observed in live run #19 is removed at the workflow boundary by supplying 900 when the Actions variable is unset.

defect_families.evidence: Reviewed against the exact Issue #459 workflow-only fallback change. The candidate changes only the timeout environment fallback from an empty Actions variable to the explicit default 900; authorization, replay, signing, persistence, provenance, publication, and fail-closed trigger validation remain unchanged.
